request.text:
A: <low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: sad.> Things went downstream after the fight. The river's carried worse. Not much worse.
<long pause>
A: <low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: happy.> Goblin children fish the far bank now. Taught one to tie a net. Don't tell the captain.
<long pause>
A: <low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: idle.> River's stopped steaming at the docks. First time since I was a boy. Feels like a held breath.
<long pause>
A: <low, unhurried, superstitious river voice Mood: idle.> Two guards on the third pier all night, watching the water. Never seen the river so well minded.
<long pause>
B: Such a mess on the bridge. Still, the road is open, and roads are so very good for business.
<long pause>
B: Feeding goblins from the town's stores. How generous. I do hope someone is keeping accounts.
<long pause>
B: How dreadful. Someone will have to decide what to do with them. Not me, I hope.
<long pause>
B: Clever. You've been listening to me. Very well, my stores for the little ones. Lent at interest, naturally.
<long pause>
B: Though I would like to know why the town's own granaries were shut so early. The mayor never did say.
<long pause>
B: Well. That does rather change the interest.
